meta.title: Signs at the Zoo
meta.textType: functional: a set of zoo signs inside a short frame story

paragraphs: Mia and her dad are at the zoo. A sign is on the door. It says: "NO DOGS." "Pip can't come here!" says Mia. Pip is at home. "What does this sign say, Mia?" asks Dad. "I can read it!" says Mia.

One sign says: "TIGERS AND BEARS." Mia and Dad look at the big tigers. Then Mia sees a sign next to the bears. It says: "PLEASE DON'T GIVE FOOD TO THE ANIMALS." "Can we give food to the bears?" asks Dad. "No, Dad! Read the sign!" says Mia. Mia points. A sign says: "SNAKES, LIZARDS AND SPIDERS." Dad sees a sign by the water. It says: "CROCODILES! DON'T SWIM HERE!" Mia and Dad smile.

"Count the hippos, Mia," says Dad. "Tell me the number." "Three!" says Mia. "Good!" says Dad. A sign is next to the giraffes. It says: "FOOD AND DRINK." Mia and Dad eat ice cream there. "Thank you, Dad!" says Mia. Mia loves the zoo. She can read the signs!
text.summary: Mia and her dad visit the zoo. Mia reads the signs, and Dad asks her what they say.

images.prompt: Mia and Mia's dad (a man of about forty with short wavy black hair and a short beard, a light blue polo shirt, khaki trousers, and brown sandals) stand at the door of a zoo. A big white sign on the door says "NO DOGS." Mia points at the sign. Her dad smiles. Nobody stands in front of the sign. Green trees and a sunny sky are behind them.
images.caption: Mia and Dad are at the zoo.

images.prompt: A sunny day at a zoo. Mia and Mia's dad (a man of about forty with short wavy black hair and a short beard, a light blue polo shirt, khaki trousers, and brown sandals) walk on a wide path and smile. Behind a tall fence on the left, a tiger and a bear rest on rocks. Four white signs stand along the path, and nobody stands in front of them. The first sign says "TIGERS AND BEARS." The second sign says "PLEASE DON'T GIVE FOOD TO THE ANIMALS." The third sign, next to a glass house with a snake, a lizard, and a spider, says "SNAKES, LIZARDS AND SPIDERS." The fourth sign, far behind a fence at a pond with a sleepy crocodile, says "CROCODILES! DON'T SWIM HERE!"
images.caption: Mia reads the signs.
